'''Helm''', along with his partner, [[Vandel]], were independent prospectors who were the first beings to discover the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandelhelm/Legends|Vandelhelm]], with the planet eventually being named after them. After penetrating the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] which encompassed the world circa [[3000 BBY]], they located several rich veins of metals and ores. After claiming the planet for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the two spacers relocated their families to the planet, and founded the [[Metalsmiths Guild|Metalsmiths' Guild]]. The two families were considered royalty for the next millennia.
